headline: DeepSeek's v4.1 Flash sets a 26.9% all-time share record as DeepSeek reaches 36.5% of tokens
summary: DeepSeek had the day, and it wasn't close. Its deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-20261017 model set an all-time token share record at 26.9%, and the provider now sits at 36.5% of all tokens. DeepSeek and OpenAI together hold 47.5%.
highlights: A fresh record, not a rerun: deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-20261017 is at 26.9% of tokens and holds rank 1.
MiniMax's minimax/minimax-m3.1-flash-20261019 climbed 23 spots over seven days to #8 and set its own all-time record at 3.5%.
Moonshot AI's moonshotai/kimi-k3.1-pro-20261023 jumped 8 places in a day to #15, also a fresh all-time record at 1.7%.
Three newcomers arrived: openai/gpt-6-luna-decisions-20261006 at #41, google/gemini-3.7-flash-20260813 at #47, and upstage/solar-pro4-20260810 at #50.
Three models fell out of the top 50: perplexity/pplx-decider-v1.2-20261016, minimax/minimax-m3-20260531, and google/gemma-4-26b-a4b-it-20260403.
DeepSeek and OpenAI, the top two providers, hold 47.5% of tokens combined.
